resolution_notes: Only free_tier_limits was disputed. Live pricing at coinmarketcap.com/api/pricing shows the free Basic plan is 10,000 credits/month (333/day) with 30 RPM; Hobbyist is a paid entry plan, not free. Original text was directionally right on ~10k credits but mislabeled Hobbyist as free and under-specified rate limits. Updated free_tier_limits to the current Basic figures; all other fields kept.
free_tier_limits: Basic (free): 10,000 credits/month (~333/day), 30 requests/minute; no monthly fee. Confirm on pricing page if tiers change.
